searchText: Hey there. @vbuterin, <@403707149043105803> and I have been discussing, over in the graveyard, some simplifications to memory and stack accounting that could stand more participants. I'd like to see Vitalik's proposal to radically simplify memory move forward https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/812719315136675850/1113498967624396811 and I've long wanted to remove the hard limit on stack https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/812719315136675850/1115454513709592676 https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/812719315136675850/1119478990080585789 the latest CL spec is here: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/3421 will be in next release in next day or so with Engine API changes here: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/420 (i need to go verify later today they are complete wrt 4788 but i think they are currently in that PR)
